query: PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/fin/> SELECT ?account ?status WHERE { ex:alice ex:transfer ?account . ?account ex:status ?status } ORDER BY DESC(?account)
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/fin/> SELECT ?status WHERE { ex:alice ex:transfer ?account . ?account ex:status ?status }
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/fin/> SELECT ?account WHERE { ex:alice ex:transfer ?account . ?account ex:status "blocked" }

PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/fin/> SELECT ?status (COUNT(?account) AS ?count) (SUM(IF(?account = ex:bob, 1, 2)) AS ?weight) WHERE { ex:alice ex:transfer ?account . ?account ex:status ?status } GROUP BY ?status ORDER BY DESC(?count) LIMIT 1
PREFIX ex: <http://example.org/fin/> SELECT ?account ?alert WHERE { ex:alice ex:watch ?account . ?account ex:alert ?alert }
